We understand that you have raised concerns regarding the statute of limitations. Pursuant to Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 47-14-103, the statute of limitations for debt collection in Tennessee is six years from the date of the last payment. Our records indicate that the last payment on the account was made on May 8, 2023. Therefore, the statute of limitations has not yet expired.

We will continue to investigate this matter and review our records to determine the next steps. If we find that the account is indeed past the statute of limitations, we will take the necessary actions to comply with applicable laws and regulations.
